name: claude-sops
description: Keep your own standard operating procedures as a versioned library of markdown files that Claude reads on demand. Ships the machinery — set up the library, write an SOP from a procedure you just worked out, edit one when reality moves, retire it, and mirror the collection across machines through a private git repo. Your CLAUDE.md gains one line pointing at the folder; the procedures themselves stay yours and stay out of context until the moment one is needed.
